description: At dusk in a dirt village yard, a barefoot man in a loose light kurta and dark trousers leans forward and holds out a few small coins toward a seated woman in a draped sari with a red-bordered cloth, who holds up cupped palms to receive them. Two more women in head coverings sit on a raised step in front of a thatched hut with bamboo walls; a small goat lies beside a bamboo stool in the foreground. Trees and other thatched huts fill the background. There is no visible text, frame, border or wall edge, and nothing graphic; the oil-painting style fills the image edge to edge.
